turns.question: What's going on with arena-smoke-20261028?
turns.reply: Arena Smoke 20261028 has a Python Pomodoro CLI committed on main. It supports a 25-minute countdown, custom durations, a completion bell and clean Ctrl-C cancellation, with documentation and automated tests. Latest commit is 14b2aa7, “Arena staged: Implement and document the Python Pomodoro CLI”; there are no uncommitted changes. I inspected the code and tests but haven’t run them, so test status is unverified.
